subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw allow same-agent owner-scoped live transcript hits to be surfaced when the combined session store has no entry, and should that ship as a narrow bug fix before the broader private recall feature?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but the outcome intentionally changes which private transcript content may become visible through memory tools, so maintainer privacy/security intent is required.

options.title: Accept Scoped Live-Orphan Fix
options.body: Approve the narrow same-agent fallback if it remains fail-closed for cross-agent, group, sandbox-denied, and basename-only orphan hits.

options.title: Fold Into Private Recall Feature
options.body: Hold the narrow fix until the broader remember-across-conversations PR defines the final authorization contract.

options.title: Keep Current Fail-Closed Behavior
options.body: Reject live orphan transcript recall without a store entry and document that operators must repair session metadata instead.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Live-Orphan Fix
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow same-agent fallback if it remains fail-closed for cross-agent, group, sandbox-denied, and basename-only orphan hits.

likelyOwner.reason: The active adjacent feature PR owns the broader private transcript recall product boundary that this bug fix must align with.
